title: Who Does the UK Trade With?

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

hint.text: Overall, the UK imports more goods and services than it exports.
hint.label: Did you know?

atoms.text: In the UK, it isn’t possible to grow tropical foods such as bananas, sugar and coffee. Instead, they are imported from countries like Spain, Kenya and Brazil.
The UK also imports many raw materials that are in short supply. Crude oil and gas is bought from Norway, the USA and the Middle East.

Manufactured goods are products made and sold by humans. Often, they are cheaper and of a higher quality when they are made elsewhere. The UK imports lots of goods from countries such as China, India and Germany.
